title: Silas and the Letters
author: Casper Blackwood
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
